title: dynaprune observation set
description: Source-agnostic, versioned bundle of externally provided per-unit signals. dynaprune never captures observations; it validates and consumes them. Units are addressed by (unit_type, layer, index) in the SOURCE model's numbering.

schema_version.description: Major.minor. Consumers refuse unknown majors and warn on newer minors.

observation_id.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of this file with this field blank. Freezes the bundle.

provider.description: Who produced the signals and how. Free of private hosts, paths and credentials.

method.description: Short description of the capture procedure (e.g. 'router probabilities over 32x2048 WikiText2 tokens').

software.description: Tool name and version used to capture.

units.description: Unit universe the signals index. Every unit_type present in signals must be declared here.

units_per_layer.description: Number of prunable units in each covered layer (e.g. routed experts).

signals.description: Named channels. Each is a dense [layer][unit] matrix aligned to units.layers × units.units_per_layer.

layer_signals.description: Optional per-layer scalars (e.g. write-gain ratio, residual norm) used by layer-adaptive rate policies.

values.description: One value per entry of units.layers, same order.

repo.description: Public model identifier (e.g. Hub repo id).

branch.description: Precision-tier branch name, if the repo has several.

precision_tier.description: Human label of the tier, e.g. '2.05bpw', 'fp8'.

shard_sha256.description: filename → SHA-256 of every weight shard the observations were captured against (or of the tier they apply to).

panelRef.description: The text/data the signals were aggregated over. Must be disjoint from any evaluation panel used later (METHOD S0).

positions.description: Number of scored token positions the signal aggregates.

kind.description: routed_mass: sum of router probability over panel tokens. route_count: times selected in top-k. error_proxy: estimated output error of the unit at its precision tier (calibration residual). kl_contribution: measured or estimated KL increase when the unit is removed. write_gain: mass-weighted norm of the unit's write into the residual stream. mean_output: per-unit mean output vector norm (needed for bias compensation). custom: see definition.

name.description: Required when kind is custom; otherwise optional label.

definition.description: Exact formula or reference. Required when kind is custom.

higher_is_more_important.description: Direction hint for rankers. error_proxy providers typically set false.

values.description: Outer index follows units.layers order; inner index is unit index in source numbering.

vectors_sha256.description: For mean_output: hash of a sidecar safetensors file holding the full vectors; values then carry norms only.
